sources.canonical_rule: GitHub releases, CI, manifests, checksums, and DOI records are canonical; Hugging Face is a generated discovery and diligence mirror.

inventory_scope.countMeaning: Anonymous author-filtered public API membership, supplemented by the reserved SZLHOLDINGS/README Space when publicly observable; each (namespace, repository ID) is counted once. Native kernels use the kernels API separately from model repositories, including legacy kernel mirrors. Cross-namespace IDs may overlap; the sum is not a unique-project or trained-model total. Not the authenticated organization total.
inventory_scope.cardEvidenceBoundary: Gated repositories are inventoried from public API metadata only. Their cardObservation is ACCESS_RESTRICTED and cardSemanticSha256 is null; metadataSha256 is not a README or weight digest. No access request, authentication, or protected download is attempted. Restricted revisions remain exact-pinned in --check.
inventory_scope.revisionFields: Every item has sha and lastModified snapshot evidence. Ungated cards have a cardSemanticSha256 claim digest at observedAt; gated cards have explicit restricted metadata evidence. --check verifies retained revisions, rejects card and curated-tag drift, and ignores only complete, valid later source-only revision changes and Hugging Face-generated dataset size, modality, format, or library tags.

sources.support_doc_sentence: The support file lists 121 model ids after the 2026-11-15 reconciliation and its same-day extension: 45 retired rows removed of which 7 were restored when the regenerated manifest re-included them, 21 measured rows added (5 in the first pass and 16 in the later pass), and 48 rows that had entered without a dated record absorbed by this record.
